name: browser-use
headline: skills and scripts for claude desktop
short_description: These are the skills in markdown as well as supporting python scripts that Claude Desktop uses when using the new skill feature.  These were provided to me in a .gz file from Claude desktop in an artifact and I haven't seen them published yet.
author: Arborist-ai

sections.overview:
Claude Desktop Skills provides a structured collection of instruction sets and helper scripts that enable Claude to create and edit professional documents with consistent formatting and standards. The skill covers Word documents, PDF handling including fillable forms, PowerPoint presentations, and Excel spreadsheets with detailed formatting rules. Users can customize color schemes, number formatting, fonts, and company-specific requirements by editing the markdown instruction files. Each file type includes a SKILL.md guide and supporting Python scripts like recalc.py for formula verification. This approach ensures consistent, professional output across all document types while allowing organizations to enforce their own branding and style standards.
Creating Excel financial models with standardized color coding for inputs, formulas, and links
Generating professional Word documents and PDFs with company formatting standards
Building PowerPoint presentations using template guidelines
Filling and processing fillable PDF forms programmatically
